'''Tube Products of India''' (TPI) ''a Unit of [[Tube Investments of India Ltd]]''. is a [[Tube (fluid conveyance)|steel tubes]] manufacturer based in India.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tiindia.com/article/divisions/13 |title=Tube Products of India |publisher=Tiindia.com |accessdate=2012-05-29}}</ref>

==History==
Tube Investments of India is a flagship company of [[Murugappa Group]]. Tube Products of India was established in collaboration with Tube Products (Old Bury) Limited, UK to produce [[Electric resistance welding]] (ERW) and [[Drawing (manufacturing)|Cold Drawn Welded]] (CDW) tubes also called as Drawn Over Mandrel tubes.

The International Business Division (IBD) gearing TPI to compete with global tube manufacturers. The most recent addition to TPI is the Tubular Components Division (TCD), which manufactures high strength tubular auto components, providing the advantage of weight reduction, higher component efficiency and cost reduction.{{citation needed|date=December 2012}}

TPI produces CRCA strips including special extra deep drawing, [[Ultimate tensile strength|high tensile]], medium carbon, high carbon finding application in industries such as [[Bearing (mechanical)|Bearing]]s, [[Automobile]], Auto Ancillaries, [[Home appliance|white goods]], [[Blanking and piercing#Fine blanking|fine blanking]] and General Engineering.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tubeproductsindia.com/Strips_Catalogue.html |title=TPI – CR Strips – Catalogue |publisher=Tubeproductsindia.com |accessdate=2012-05-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.murugappa.com/companies/tube_investment/TubeProducts_index.htm |title=Murugappa Group | Companies | Tube Products |publisher=Murugappa.com |date=2007-06-29 |accessdate=2012-05-29}}</ref>
